nguon: Resuscitation Council UK. Paediatric Life Support (basic and advanced), 2025/2026: https://www.resus.org.uk/cy/node/36439 ; RCUK Paediatric emergency drug chart, January 2026: https://www.resus.org.uk/sites/default/files/2026-01/RCUK%20Paediatric%20emergency%20algorithms%20and%20resources%20Jan%2026%20V4_0.pdf

trich: Mục Drowning: “Give 100% oxygen as soon as it is available.”; phần Breathing: “Initially give 100% oxygen for all children with respiratory, circulatory, or neurological failure.”

text: 2) Cởi bỏ đồ ướt, ủ ấm bằng chăn ấm và dịch ấm đến khi nhiệt độ trên 36 độ C.
nguon: Resuscitation Council UK. Paediatric Life Support (basic and advanced), 2025/2026: https://www.resus.org.uk/cy/node/36439
trich: Mục Drowning: “Start rewarming if < 35°C and rewarm at a rate of at least 1°C h−1. Aim for normothermia but stop active rewarming at 35°C to avoid overshoot hyperthermia.”; “Give warmed and humidified 100% oxygen and warmed IV/IO fluids (39-42°C)”.
de_xuat: Bắt đầu làm ấm khi nhiệt độ trung tâm <35°C; mục tiêu là trở về thân nhiệt bình thường nhưng ngừng làm ấm chủ động khi đạt 35°C để tránh tăng thân nhiệt quá mức.

text: 3) NaCl 0,9% 10 mL/kg (200 mL) bolus, đánh giá lại.
